summary: Noah Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K providing a supplemental announcement regarding its second quarter and half year 2026 earnings conference call. The filing updates dial-in details for the call, noting that previously disclosed Hong Kong and Mainland China toll-free numbers are no longer available. It references a prior announcement dated August 13, 2026, and confirms all other information remains unchanged. This is a routine administrative update to an earnings call schedule, not a special situation. No strategic corporate actions, transactions, or management changes are involved.
